title: Define a minimum SGI baseline and progressive maturity levels
requirements:
- Identify the minimum SGI capabilities needed before a country publishes national terminology, models or IGs, and mark which belong to the REDDHI baseline
- Define the minimum semantic-governance baseline (ownership, identifiers, versioning, approval, change control) needed before data structures go live
- Explain how the terminology maturity model extends to other artefact types
- Clarify that governed models exist from the outset but may be published through simpler means first
- Describe progressive maturity stages and give short examples at each level
- Place that baseline in Phases 1–2, reserving advanced SGI capabilities for Phase 3
- Describe the criteria distinguishing each maturity level so maturity is not read as technology sophistication
- Describe a maturity path rather than mandatory runtime prerequisites
